judgement.reason: Memos supports PostgreSQL via MEMOS_DRIVER/MEMOS_DSN and S3 for attachments, so a contained change (build arg default and frontend build step) suffices.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/opt/memos (scripts/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not prove that a setting moves everything stored in /var/opt/memos, such as uploaded attachments, to PostgreSQL or S3, so the volume may hold durable data that would be lost on restart.
